name: Black Stair L5: The Threshold Is A Lie

description.value:
Wards aren't walls. They're paperwork.

When you use your class's The Crossing ability (Class Tier 2) on a magical barrier, treat the barrier's check DC as if it were 2 lower.

Additionally, you leave no magical trace of the crossing — divination cast after the fact does not reveal that you passed, no alarm aftermath fires, no scrying residue lingers — unless the barrier was specifically warded against your character or class. Most weren't, because most wardmakers don't know you exist.

If a barrier is specifically warded against you, the DC reduction still applies, but the no-trace effect does not.

system.requirements: Route of the Black Stair, Shadow Courier Initiation 5
